::: {#exm-simulation-study}
#### A simulation study of a variance estimator

<!-- no-figure: the example describes the design of a study -->

For the [normal data-generating process](#exm-data-generating-process),
a [simulation study](#def-simulation-study) of one [estimator](estimation.qmd#def-estimator) of the variance $\varpar$
runs $M$ [replications](#exm-replication) of that process and that estimator.
The $M$ [estimates](estimation.qmd#def-estimate) $T_1, \ldots, T_M$ then show how the estimator behaves across repeated data sets.
:::
